name: Meprobamate
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Carisoprodol tablets, Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — meprobamate half-life approximately 10 hours
halfLifeNotes: Measured as carisoprodol's metabolite in 24 healthy subjects (9.7 +/- 1.7 h and 9.6 +/- 1.5 h at the two doses); the meprobamate product label itself carries no PK section.
